claim: With the AWS Organizations AI services opt-out policy you can opt out of the use of your content for service improvement; when you opt out, the AI service deletes the associated historical content shared with AWS before, limited to stored content that is not required to provide service functions.

qualifiers.condition: deletion is limited to stored content not required to provide service functions

evidence.quote: You can opt out of use of your content for service improvement by using the AWS Organizations opt-out policy.
When you opt out of content use by an AWS AI service, that service deletes all of the associated historical content that was shared with AWS before you set the option.
This deletion is limited to content stored that is not required to provide service functions.
